incarnation: Nexus de Convergence — Nadir Kest, canon original du projet2026, atlas courant4×4 et dossier de personnage

limitations: Original project generated atlas retained as internal character canon, never an independent franchise reference.
No separate facial portrait or item model; small details limited to sprite resolution.

visualLocks.face: Warm olive/tan skin, dark eyes, short tousled black hair, light stubble; no hat, helmet or full face mask.
visualLocks.anatomy: Human man, two arms/two legs; no extra limbs. Exact age not documented.
visualLocks.costume: Navy/dark-teal segmented rescue armor and high scarf collar, grey-black harness straps, belt/thigh pouches, reinforced knees, navy segmented boots and gloves.
visualLocks.palette: Primary navy #183a4a and turquoise #5ce1d8, cyan mechanical highlights; no orange Bastion or red Marrow palette.
visualLocks.equipment: One short dark cyan-lit pistol, central mechanical chest cable reel with three curved cyan ribs, one small dark spherical low-domed return probe with short side fins attached to harness by a cyan cable.
visualLocks.forbiddenMixes: No Anchor gauntlet, Loom medical cross, Nova long staff/monocle, Marrow coral blade, hat/coat of a mapmaker, extra drone or imported franchise gear.

loreEvidence.role: Safe-line opening and extraction through hostile portals; Return Runner.
loreEvidence.doctrine: Probe must return with same wear and elapsed time; harness tension proves a reciprocal exit. First into unknown routes, last to sever his line.

limitations: Atlas interne généré retenu par le projet = autorité visuelle de cette création originale, aucune source de licence externe.
Résolution limitée du visage, de la sonde et des articulations; aucune perfection1:1 automatiquement certifiée.
Aucun âge chiffré dans le dossier; scènes familiales et non romantiques.
